models_evaluated: AI Decision Aid for antidepressant selection (conversational, LLM-based)

links.outcome: Decision aid concept retrieval and recommendation accuracy across health literacy levels
links.effect: Rank-1 concept retrieval rose from 47.6% (limited health literacy) to 81.9% (proficient), with corresponding declines in antidepressant recommendation accuracy.
links.quote: Rank-1 concept retrieval increased from 47.6% for limited health literacy to 81.9% for proficient health literacy, with corresponding declines in antidepressant recommendation accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Patient simulation framework (medical, linguistic, behavioral profiles) aligned with NIST AI RMF for pre-deployment risk assessment of conversational AI
LLM-as-judge validation against human annotators for simulated patient profile fidelity

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a patient simulation framework to empirically evaluate performance and safety risks of an LLM conversational decision aid under diverse patient profiles.

primary.practice: simulated patient stress-testing across health literacy and behavioral variation
